name: Maker-side reward-pool farming (liquidity rewards, sponsored pools, event programmes, Polymarket US LIP)
one_line: Rest two-sided quotes inside each market's reward band so the published subsidy, not the spread, is the income; size by achievable share of a pool's score, not by pool size.
maturity: Established for a handful of automated wallets; decayed for 2024-style newcomers; Emerging on the US venue (no realised payout data)
requires_ai: optional: jump-risk classification of markets, changelog re-parameterisation
edge: Treasury pays for displayed depth; pools published per market, maker count is not equilibrated
capital: $10k+ internationally ($1k-$10k only on sub-$50/day pools); fills lock capital to resolution, top farmer has ~$250k parked to 2028
build_time: 2-4 weeks on an existing LP stack, +1-2 weeks for the US venue; 2-3 months from scratch
opportunity_size: Realised international payouts $108k-$170k/day (~$45-60M/yr), a quarter to ten wallets; saturating, cut repeatedly in 2026
expected_results: Top two farmers ~$2.5k-$3.1k/day rewards on $320k-$830k books; median recipient $5/day; solo guess $30-$150/day gross
competition: Ten wallets take 24% of payouts; 500-market bots; desks on US venue
flag: none for one-identity two-sided quoting; prohibited for flicker, spoof, multi-wallet variants
validate: Two weeks read-only share replay on top 300 pools minus markouts; pass at >= $1.5 net per $1k/day over 20 days
top_risk: Discretionary programme cuts and adverse selection erase the subsidy
solo_fit_reason: Fully enumerable, no capital at risk to validate, and the on-chain distributor makes competitors' earnings observable; but the payout distribution says a newcomer lands near the $30-$350/day band at best, the two proven farmers run 40k-210k trades a month across hundreds of markets with six-figure books, and every parameter is Polymarket's to cut. A solid overlay on an existing LP engine, weak as a standalone business.
open_doubts: Net-of-markout PnL is unpublished for every wallet below the top three; the file's solo estimate is a labelled guess anchored on the payout distribution, not on any bot's books.
The Kalshi maker -10% comparator rests on a search snippet (SSRN 5502658 never fetched).
No realised Polymarket US LIP payout figure exists; the $20.1M of configured US caps may pay a small fraction, as the international $585k-vs-$128k Sunday gap shows.
Whether holding rewards accrue on a complete YES+NO set is inferred from the formula, not confirmed by Polymarket.
PolyScalping's lifetime tallies exceed the Data API's by 2-9%; attributed to the API's multi-day lag, not reconciled transfer by transfer.
